versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00425, SRS_BSW_00432 The AUTOSAR COM module shall execute all functions of its signal gateway dur- ing the function call Com_MainFunctionRouteSignals . During this function call, the AUTOSAR COM module’s signal gateway shall check received routed signals and group signals and copy them from the related receive I-PDUs to the related transmit I-PDUs.
